description:
Super Hexagon is a game where you play as a triangle avoiding dastardly hexagon walls.
You must survive at all costs!

1.1.0.description:
## New
- Added a new option to specify how long you need to survive on your goal level to goal it.
- Added a new option to choose your starting level, to allow for a random starting level. 
- Added a new option to disable specific hyper levels you are not interested in playing. (Hyper Hexagonest is also now disabled by default.)
- Added `/goal` and `/survival_times` commands to the client, to display goal and survival time.
- Added `Hexagon Unlock` as an item, to account for changes to starting level.
- Added Option Groups.

## Changes
- Changed the goal level to actually take you to the in game "game completed" screen when you goal.
- Split up the Survival Time option into per level options, allowing you to specify how long you want to be expected to survive on each level.
- Increased the Survival Time ranges to 240 seconds max, from 180.
- Added Hexagon as a valid goal level, in accordance to the new starting level changes.

## Fixes
- Fixed bug where the goal level would display as `GOAL:` when you don't have hexagon fragments or level beaten requirements set. It will now display `GOAL: NEEDS UNLOCK` if all you need is the level unlock item.
